top_stories.title: Records of charges against US Capitol rioters removed - World - DAWN.COM
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **US Justice Department** has removed hundreds of press releases detailing criminal charges related to the January 6th, 2021 attack on the US Capitol from its website. The department claims this action is part of a move to remove "partisan propaganda" and that it's proud to reverse what it calls the "weaponization" of the Justice Department under the Biden administration. This comes after reports that the Trump administration was quietly deleting information about the attack, including press releases detailing the investigation and charges brought against individuals involved.

top_stories.title: Taiwan Military Activity: Taiwan detects Chinese military aircraft, naval vessels near island for second straight day - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Taiwan's** ministry of national defense reported detecting four sorties of **Chinese military aircraft** and six naval vessels operating around the island until 6 am local time on Sunday. Three of the four aircraft crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait and entered Taiwan’s southwestern and southeastern Air Defense Identification Zone (ADIZ).  The **ROC Armed Forces** monitored the situation and responded, following similar activity detected on Saturday involving 16 aircraft sorties and eight naval vessels. The repeated incursions come amid rising tensions between China and Taiwan, with Beijing continuing military operations near the self-ruled island.

top_stories.title: I survived a missile strike in the Strait of Hormuz, but my friend has not been found
top_stories.rephrased_article: A missile strike on the oil tanker Skylight in the Strait of Hormuz killed **Dalip Rathore**, 25, and injured others.  The attack, which occurred on March 1st, was the first commercial vessel to be struck after the US-Israel war with Iran erupted. The ship's owner, Red Sea Ship Management, based in Dubai, is unidentifiable and unresponsive to inquiries. **Sunil Puniya**, 26, a crew member on the Skylight, lost his friend and remains traumatized by the experience.  The incident highlights the growing dangers faced by seafarers in the Strait of Hormuz due to geopolitical conflicts, with many vessels stranded and facing abandonment by their shipowners. The International Transport Workers' Federation (ITF) reports a surge in abandoned seafarers, highlighting the need for improved maritime regulations and accountability.

top_stories.title: Dozens feared trapped in Philippines building collapse - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Jay Pelayo**, the Angeles City information officer, reported that an incident at a construction site resulted in the collapse of a building.  Eight people were rescued and 11 others escaped, including the site foreman. **Pelayo** stated that approximately 30 to 40 individuals remain missing and search and rescue operations are ongoing. The cause of the collapse is under investigation by the city engineer, who is reviewing the construction history. Rescue efforts are being hindered by the structure's concrete composition.

top_stories.title: White House shooting: 21-year-old Nasire Best, who identified himself as Jesus Christ, shot dead - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: A gunman, identified as Nasire Best, 21, opened fire at a security checkpoint outside the White House on Saturday evening. **Secret Service** personnel responded with gunfire, killing **Best** and injuring at least one bystander.  The shooting occurred while President Donald Trump was inside the White House during diplomatic discussions related to Iran and a proposed peace framework involving Middle Eastern nations. The FBI launched an investigation into the incident, which prompted a lockdown of the White House complex for approximately 40 minutes.

top_stories.title: PM Modi Jhalmuri break: Security stepped up at stall which Modi had visited in West Bengal - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Bikram Kumar Sau**, a Jhalmuri vendor in Jhargram town, West Bengal, has reported receiving threatening phone calls and messages after **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** visited his stall during the state assembly election campaign.  The **Jhargram police** have launched an investigation into the threats, with security personnel posted outside the stall to protect Sau and his family. The incident gained national attention and contributed to the BJP's victory in the district.

top_stories.title: US-Iran deal in sight as CDF wraps up trip - World - DAWN.COM
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Field Marshal Asim Munir**, the Chief of Defence Forces, concluded a visit to **Tehran** after intense negotiations with Iranian officials aimed at ending the conflict.  The discussions focused on de-escalation and achieving a final agreement. While no breakthrough was announced, **President Donald Trump** claimed significant progress had been made towards a peace deal that would open the Strait of Hormuz. The talks also included proposals from **Iran** and **Pakistan** to end the war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.  Despite these developments, **Iranian** officials emphasized their commitment to achieving their goals while maintaining a hardline stance.

top_stories.title: Rosenberg: Luhansk strike sparks Russian accusations and vow to retaliate
top_stories.rephrased_article: A five-story building in the Russian-occupied town of Starobilsk, Luhansk region, was destroyed in an attack early Friday. **Russia** has accused **Ukraine** of carrying out a drone strike on the college dormitory, claiming 21 lives and 42 injuries.  **Vladimir Putin** called it a "terrorist strike" while **Ukraine's Armed Forces** stated they targeted a Russian military unit. The **United Nations Security Council** convened an emergency session at Russia's request, with some members condemning the attack as a war crime.

top_stories.title: White House Shooting: Who was Nasire Best? Maryland man who allegedly believed he was ‘Jesus Christ’ killed after gunfire near Donald Trump’s home - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Nasire Best**, a 21-year-old Maryland man, is the suspect in a shooting near the White House security perimeter. **Best** had prior encounters with federal security agencies due to mental health struggles and repeated violations of court orders related to his presence near the White House complex.  The incident occurred on July 10, 2025, when **Best** allegedly bypassed a restricted checkpoint and fired at **Secret Service** officers. The motive behind the shooting remains under investigation, but reports suggest **Best** may have believed himself to be "Jesus Christ".

top_stories.title: Iran refutes Trump's 'largely negotiated' deal, claims to keep Hormuz control - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **President Donald Trump** announced on Truth Social that the US and **Iran** have “largely negotiated” a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, potentially ending months of conflict. However, **Iran** disputes these claims, stating that the Strait will remain under its control according to a draft proposal awaiting approval from supreme leader **Mojtaba Khamenei**.  While **Trump** expressed optimism about progress and highlighted support from regional leaders, including **Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif**, **Israel** remains cautious about any interim agreement due to concerns over Iran's nuclear program.
